p2BME680Init.summary: Selects the I2C pins and verifies address 118/119 plus chip ID before configuring the BME680.
prerequisites: Import P2 Sensors and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. P2 BME680 SDA: number; library example 8.

examples.title: Use P2 BME680 SDA … SCL … address …
examples.code: P2 BME680 SDA [8] SCL [9] address [119]
examples.explanation: Block notation: Selects the I2C pins and verifies address 118/119 plus chip ID before configuring the BME680. Boolean detection/initialization success.

notes: Candidate extension-9 firmware required; not in the reviewed revision-8 installer. BME680, LIS3DH and LSM9DS1 use portable libraries and explicit I2C pins. DHT22 uses bounded cached reads; NMEA GPS shares the buffered UART; PING has a bounded timeout and PIR uses digital input. Units and failures are explicit on blocks. No hardware probe on import. Hardware acceptance pending.
Source: boards\propeller2\integration\libraries\P2 Sensors.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.

prerequisites: Import P2 Sensors and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. P2 DHT22 pin: number; library example 13.

examples.title: Use P2 DHT22 pin … (list or false)
examples.code: P2 DHT22 pin [13] (list or false)
examples.explanation: Block notation: Reads a DHT22 with bounded timing and cached readings rather than an unbounded wait. Measurement list or false; inspect the native contract before interpreting list fields.

notes: Candidate extension-9 firmware required; not in the reviewed revision-8 installer. BME680, LIS3DH and LSM9DS1 use portable libraries and explicit I2C pins. DHT22 uses bounded cached reads; NMEA GPS shares the buffered UART; PING has a bounded timeout and PIR uses digital input. Units and failures are explicit on blocks. No hardware probe on import. Hardware acceptance pending.
Source: boards\propeller2\integration\libraries\P2 Sensors.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
The native backend waits for two seconds of uptime before its first read and caches one pin for two seconds. Rapidly switching pins does not produce independent fresh readings.
